title: Linux Fundamentals
description: Comprehensive course covering Linux operating system fundamentals, command-line, system administration, and shell scripting

topics.title: Introduction to Linux
topics.description: Comprehensive foundation of Linux, its history, distributions, and core concepts for beginners

topics.title: Linux System Architecture
topics.description: Deep dive into Linux kernel, system components, boot process, and system structure

topics.title: Linux File System
topics.description: In-depth study of file system hierarchy, file types, permissions, and file management

topics.title: Command Line Essentials
topics.description: Comprehensive guide to bash shell, essential commands, text processing, and command-line utilities

topics.title: User and Group Management
topics.description: Detailed coverage of user accounts, groups, permissions, sudo, and access control

topics.title: Package Management
topics.description: Extensive coverage of package managers (apt, yum, dnf), repositories, and software installation

topics.title: Shell Scripting
topics.description: Comprehensive guide to bash scripting, automation, variables, loops, and functions

topics.title: System Administration
topics.description: In-depth coverage of processes, services, monitoring, logging, and system maintenance

learningOutcomes: Understand Linux architecture and core concepts
Navigate and manage the Linux file system efficiently
Master essential command-line tools and utilities
Manage users, groups, and permissions effectively
